privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {{club}} ("the club") processes in its app, why, for how long, and what your rights are. The app runs on the Tatami Studio platform.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: The controller is {{club}}. The club decides what data is collected and why. For questions and requests, contact the coach or the club.
Tatami Studio (tatamistudio.net) is the processor: it runs the app on the club's behalf under a written contract and does not use the data for its own purposes. Contact: hristo@varbanov.eu.

sections.title: What data we process
body: About the student: name, birth year, group, belt, club status, attendance (including QR check-in at the hall, if the club uses it), coach grades (if the club uses them), competitions, monthly fees paid (amount, date and method: cash, card on the POS terminal or bank) and club store reservations.
Optional: ЕГН (Bulgarian personal number), phone, email, photo, height and weight.
About a parent or guardian: name, phone and email, to get in touch about the child.
For logging in: a username or email and a password. The password is only stored encrypted and nobody can see it. We also record when you confirmed reading this policy.
Technical: chosen language, your login session and a temporary copy of the schedule on your device so the app works offline.

sections.title: Purposes and legal basis
body: Running classes, groups, belts, attendance and fees, i.e. performing the club membership (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Coach messages, grades and progress tracking: the club's legitimate interest in running its training (Art. 6(1)(f)).
ЕГН: only where needed to register students with the federation, for competitions and insurance. It is not required to use the app.
Height and weight: for kimono and equipment sizes and competition categories.
Photo: only so the coach recognises the student in the app. It is never published.

sections.title: Children
body: Most students are children. For children under 14 the data is provided, and the login used, by the parent or guardian. One login can cover several children in a family.
Logins are created only by the club coach. There is no open sign-up.

sections.title: Who sees the data
body: The club's coaches and management see the data of their own club's students. The ЕГН is hidden until tapped.
Parents see their own children's data. No student or parent ever sees another child's data.
The Tatami Studio team has access only as far as needed to maintain and fix the app.
Data is never sold or shared with advertisers.

sections.title: Where it is stored
body: In a Supabase database on servers in the EU (Ireland). The app is served by Render. Both are providers we work with under data processing agreements and the EU standard contractual clauses.
Connections are encrypted, and every user can reach only the data their role allows.

sections.title: How long
body: While the student is a club member. After they leave, the club deletes the data within 12 months unless the law requires keeping it longer.
You can ask for earlier deletion at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to and port your data. Write to the club or to hristo@varbanov.eu and we will reply within one month.
You can complain to the Bulgarian Commission for Personal Data Protection (www.cpdp.bg).

sections.title: Cookies
body: We only use necessary local storage: language, login and an offline copy of the schedule. No advertising or tracking cookies.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of {{club}}'s app, built on the Tatami Studio platform. By confirming them on your first login you accept them.

sections.title: What the app offers
body: The class schedule, belt and grades, attendance, fees paid, competitions, coach messages and, if the club uses them, the store and QR check-in.
Coaches have a panel where they manage their club's students, attendance, fees and messages.

sections.title: Logging in
body: Your login is created by the coach. Keep the password secret and change it in Profile after your first login.
If you lose your password or think someone else uses your login, tell the coach.

sections.title: Fees and store
body: Fees are paid to the club in cash, by card or by bank transfer. The app only shows what the coach has recorded and takes no payments.
A store reservation is not a purchase: you pay and collect the item at the hall.

sections.title: Children
body: For children under 14 the login is used by the parent or guardian, who is responsible for the data entered.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Use the app only as intended. Trying to access other people's data, or checking in with the QR code without being at the hall, is not allowed.

sections.title: Liability
body: We do our best to keep the app running, but cannot guarantee it will never be interrupted.
The club is responsible for its classes and students' safety. Tatami Studio only provides the software.

sections.title: Ending
body: You can ask for your login to be closed and your data deleted at any time. The club may suspend a login that breaks these terms.

sections.title: Changes and law
body: If these terms change we will ask you to confirm them again. Bulgarian law applies.
Contact: the club or hristo@varbanov.eu.
